exposure: Newborns exposed to stress conditions (complications during labor and delivery)
stress conditions during labor and delivery
Healthy mothers vs mothers with severe pre-eclampsia
outcome: B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) levels in umbilical cord blood
cohort: 167 healthy newborns (146 from healthy mothers and 21 from mothers with severe pre-eclampsia)
finding: BNP concentrations at birth were lower in healthy newborns compared to previous reports, and newborns of mothers with pre-eclampsia and those exposed to stress conditions had higher BNP levels.
